text.p: Shares in Guardian Royal Exchange Plc bounced back toward their record peaks set earlier this month after the group's annual results failed to meet traders' worst expectations, dealers said on Tuesday.
At 0856 GMT, the shares were up 5-1/2p to 293-1/2, only 7-1/2p away from their February 12 record high.
Guardian shares eased yesterday amid worries the insurer would disappoint investors with its profits, dealers said.
Guardian said its annual trading profits fell to 281 million stg, as expected, but said it was raising the dividend payout for the year by 11.1 percent.
"The numbers were basically in line. It's a relief as much as anything else," said one market maker.
Shares in Commercial Union and Prudential Corp also bounced back ahead of their results tomorrow.
Commercial Union shares were up 8p to 709, while shares in Prudential firmed 4-1/2p to 564. Shares in both companies eased yesterday.
Elsewhere, shares in Legal & General rose 5p to 407, while shares in General Accident climbed 10p to 818-1/2p. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 5601
